description: Walk the Biomiv interaction network of genes, proteins, enzymes, biochemicals, plant compounds, drug compounds, pathways and conditions. One name: its known links (each with its relation and source), the enzymes before and after it in metabolism, and its hidden leads (records two known links away that no source links directly). Two names: the chains of known links between them. Free, no account needed. Research information, not medical advice.

terms.description: one name, or two names separated by " and " (e.g. "GCDH", or "L-lysine and GCDH")
